method.binary_size: per executable/library artifact; .text and .text.* section totals, no summing compatibility aliases
method.build_cost: No build-time comparison is inferred. Stage logs/timings and warm ccache make this archive insufficient for clean cold-build cost.
method.counters: hardware-r1 counters cover full user-space process startup/setup/subprocesses; probe wall time is internal scenario timing. Process instructions are not kernel instructions.
method.editor_render: render uses --profile until settled rather than a fixed frame count; instruction changes can reflect variable rendered work/races and are reported, not asserted as a regression.
method.ratio: treatment median wall seconds / control median wall seconds; below 1 is lower observed wall time
method.serial_measurements: matching pairing IDs ensure workload identity only; modes ran in separate serial blocks, not simultaneously paired runs
method.uncertainty: independent-block bootstrap of the median ratio; resample each serial mode's seven measured samples independently, 10000 resamples, 95% percentile interval
